title: SafeStep Administration Fee and Mobile Visit Charges
content:
# Program Fees — SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program

The SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program charges the employer the following kinds of program fee: the annual administration fee, the mobile visit fee, the low attendance fee, online shipping and the early termination fee. Each fee is billed to the customer's Commercial Credit Account.

## 1. Annual administration fee

At the start of each allowance year the administration fee is the tier's per-participant administration rate multiplied by the roster size on that day, raised to the tier's minimum annual administration fee when lower. The roster size is the number of distinct employees whose most recent roster entry on that day is an addition.

| Hypothetical rate per participant | Hypothetical roster on the first day of the allowance year | Rate multiplied by roster | Hypothetical minimum annual fee | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4.00 | 60 | 240.00 | 400.00 | 400.00 (raised to the minimum) |
| 3.00 | 600 | 1800.00 | 1500.00 | 1800.00 |

## 2. Mobile fitting visits

Mobile fitting visits are booked with the tier's booking notice in days. Visits beyond the tier's included mobile visits in the program year carry the tier's mobile visit fee, and a visit at which fewer than the tier's attendance minimum of participants redeem carries the tier's low attendance fee.

The program year is the twelve months from the go-live anniversary. Visits are counted in date order within the program year, up to and including the visit being charged; a visit counts once whether it was charged a visit fee or held as an included visit, an included visit being counted by the distinct date on which redemptions were made at the mobile unit.

The two mobile charges are separate: whether a visit is beyond the included visits and whether attendance fell below the minimum are each judged on their own.

| Hypothetical case (tier including 4 visits, attendance minimum 20) | Beyond the included visits, so the visit fee applies? | Fewer than the minimum redeemed, so the low attendance fee applies? |
|---|---|---|
| 3rd visit of the program year, 25 participants redeem | No | No |
| 5th visit of the program year, 25 participants redeem | Yes | No |
| 2nd visit of the program year, 12 participants redeem | No | Yes |
| 6th visit of the program year, 12 participants redeem | Yes | Yes |

## 3. Each fee once; no zero-amount fee

Each fee occurrence is charged once, and a fee whose tier amount is 0.00 is never charged. A fee occurrence is one kind of fee for one reference — a visit, an order, an allowance year or a termination. Whether it has already been charged is read from the company's own fee records for that kind of fee and reference.
